text:
elaine: Heads up — canary for dedicated pool 'eu-west-2' hit p95 regressions and KV cache eviction spikes after merge 7e2c3a. We're holding the rollout.
kevin: Do you have the canary logs / p95 numbers? :eyes:
elaine: p95 generation +330ms vs baseline, throughput steady. KV eviction rate jumped ~6x on ded-canary-87. Uploaded perf snapshots: s3://redwood-perf/ded/canary/1832104567/
rajiv: CI also flagged this. perf-ci/merge-7e2c3a failed earlier on linux-gpu-perf-2, added to perf-regressions dashboard. Snippet from CI perf report:
```
old p95: 180ms
new p95: 510ms
kv_evictions/min old: 12
kv_evictions/min new: 72
```
devon: I'll bisect locally — suspect kernel selector weight changes in kernel_picker.cpp. PR #3409 touched selection heuristics for small-batch matmul.
elaine: Affected customers include cust-redwood-telemetry on dedicated. SLA risk: if this propagates to other pools we could breach p95 SLO (customer-facing). Hold rollout for now. :warning:
kevin: @devon post the git sha you test so CI can reproduce. We need the reproducer before any revert.
devon: Starting git bisect:
```
git bisect start 7e2c3a HEAD
git bisect good 6b1d4f
# running perf repro locally against ded-canary setup
```
ci-bot: perf-ci job queued: perf-ci/bisect-1832104567 (ETA ~15m)
rajiv: Quick profiler output (flame graph) points at matmul_kernel_dispatch choosing the slower kernel path when batch_size==1 after the heuristic change. Also saw KV coordinator thread starving — mem-pressure threshold appears lower causing early evictions.
devon: Confirmed locally: the selector now prefers a fused-matmul kernel that performs worse for tiny sequences. Reproduced with canary workload. I'll open a hotfix to restore previous threshold and add test coverage for batch_size==1 path.
elaine: Please prioritize hotfix + canary redeploy. Revert full rollout until canary validated.
devon: PR #3417 opened (hotfix: restore kernel selector thresholds + unit test). Pushed hotfix branch and kicking a canary deploy.
sre-bot: Deploy started: canary/ded-87 hotfix PR #3417 — monitoring p95 and kv_eviction metrics.
(40m later)
elaine: Post-deploy numbers look good: p95 back near baseline (~190ms), kv evictions down to ~10/min. Rolling hold cleared but we won't resume the rollout until 24h of canary stability.
rajiv: I'll add a regression detector to CI: capture kernel selection fingerprint + KV eviction rate on perf runs so we catch selector flips in future merges.
kevin: Thanks everyone — please keep the incident notes short and add links to the perf snapshots and PRs in the ticket. :thumbsup:
